text:
Anya: Quick kickoff — planning a PLG experiment for next Wed: 'Bootcamp + Bench' — 90-min webinar + 3-day hands-on bootcamp with free credits (500 tokens) + starter prompt templates. Goal: +20% 7-day activation. Need owners for messaging, inbound routing, onboarding flows, and launch posts.
Sam: Love it. I can own webinar landing copy + benchmarks. Do we have a benchmark narrative? Need baseline numbers.
Maria: I can take inbound routing — map leads into 3 cohorts: webinar-only, bootcamp-active, self-serve. Will need a webhook + tags. Proposed tagging schema: workshop=bootcamp, cohort=bench, credit_grant=yes.
Leo: I’ll own prompt templates & onboarding nudges (starter prompts + 2 quick wins). Planning 3 template packs: marketing, dev, ops.
Jordan: Timeline?
Anya: Timeline: assets + writeup by Mon EOD, landing + routing by Tue noon, deploy credit grants Wed 9am, webinar Wed 12pm PT. Can we automate grant via /grant_credits API? @Eli
Eli: Yes — ops can run a short job. Proposing endpoint: 

````
POST https://internal-api/grant_credits
Body: {"user_id":"{id}","amount":500,"metadata":{"campaign":"bootcamp-bench"}}
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>
````

I'll add logging + audit hooks.
growth-bot: Grant job scheduled (sandbox): curl -X POST https://internal-api/grant_credits -d '{"user_id":"{id}","amount":500,"metadata":{"campaign":"bootcamp-bench"}}' 
Sam: For benchmark narrative I'll track baseline metrics: weekly new users -> activation rate, avg session length, first-10 prompt success. Shared doc: https://docs.redwood/workbench/bootcamp-bench (placeholder).
Maria: Inbound routing config snippet (pseudo):

```
if source == 'webinar' then tag = 'webinar'
elsif utm_campaign =~ /bootcamp/ then tag = 'bootcamp'
else tag = 'selfserve'
end
```

Will wire tags to cohort assignment and to Amplitude.
Leo: Prompt outlines: 1) Summarize product docs 2) Generate first reply 3) Create 3-shot examples. Will surface 3 quick wins in onboarding nudge.
Anya: Copy review request: short hero + 3 bullets + CTA to claim credits. Sam please drop draft by tonight.
Jordan: I can help with social launch posts and benchmark narrative visuals. Need stats from Sam by EOD.
Maria: I'll set up tracking events: funnel.activation.received_credits, funnel.activation.first_success. Hook to GA + Amplitude.
Anya: Owners recap: Landing = Sam, Routing = Maria, Credits job = Eli, Prompts = Leo, Social = Jordan. Daily check-in 10am next week.
Sam: Noted. I'll post draft here when ready. :thumbsup:
Leo: Starting template pack now, will ping when first version landed.
Eli: I'll prep sandbox script and run a dry-run Thu morning.
growth-bot: Reminder: create calendar event "Bootcamp + Bench — Launch" Wed 12pm PT — invite: Anya, Sam, Maria, Leo, Jordan, Eli.
Anya: Thanks everyone — small ask: keep copy tight and highlight free credits + 3 quick wins. We’ll iterate after first cohort.
